# f5xc_azure_vnet_site_set_cloud_site_info (Resource)

Azure VNet site view defines a required parameters that can be used in CRUD, to create and manage a volterra site in Azure VNet.<br>It can be used to automatically site creation in the Azure VNet.<br><br>View will create following child objects.<br><br>* Site

To get more information about f5xc_azure_vnet_site_set_cloud_site_info, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/views-azure-vnet-site)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Azure Vnet Site Set Cloud Site Info - Full

resource "f5xc_azure_vnet_site" "site" {
  name      = "example-azure-vnet-cloud-info-jdsn8k"
  namespace = "system"

  resource_group = "example-azure-rg"

  region_choice = {
    azure_region = "eastus2"
  }

  vnet = {
    choice = {
      new_vnet = {
        name_choice = {
          autogenerate = true
        }
        primary_ipv4 = "10.30.0.0/16"
      }
    }
  }

  site_type_choice = {
    ingress_gw = {
      azure_certified_hw = "azure-byol-voltmesh"
      az_nodes = [{
        azure_az = "1"
        local_subnet = {
          choice = {
            subnet_param = {
              ipv4 = "10.30.1.0/24"
            }
          }
        }
      }]
    }
  }

  deployment_choice = {
    azure_cred = {
      name      = "example-azure-cred"
      namespace = "system"
    }
  }

  machine_type = "Standard_D4s_v4"
  ssh_key      = "ssh-rsa "

  worker_nodes_choice = {
    no_worker_nodes = true
  }

  logs_receiver_choice = {
    logs_streaming_disabled = true
  }

  blocked_services_choice = {
    block_all_services = true
  }

  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = all
  }
}


resource "f5xc_azure_vnet_site_set_cloud_site_info" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_azure_vnet_site.site.name
  namespace = "system"

  azure_vnet_info = {
    public_ips  = ["20.50.50.50", "20.50.50.51", "20.50.50.52"]
    private_ips = ["10.50.50.50", "10.50.50.51", "10.50.50.52"]
    express_route_info = {
      route_server_asn = 65445
      route_server_ips = ["10.50.0.4", "10.50.0.5"]
    }
    node_info = [
      {
        node_id            = "ves-node-id-2001"
        node_instance_name = "vm-node-1"
      },
      {
        node_id            = "ves-node-id-2002"
        node_instance_name = "vm-node-2"
      }
    ]
    spoke_vnet_prefix_info = [
      {
        prefixes = ["10.51.0.0/24"]
        vnet = {
          resource_group = "spoke-rg-b"
          vnet_name      = "spoke-vnet-b"
          routing_type_choice = {
            f5_orchestrated_routing = true
          }
        }
      },
      {
        prefixes = ["10.52.0.0/24"]
        vnet = {
          resource_group = "spoke-rg-c"
          vnet_name      = "spoke-vnet-c"
          routing_type_choice = {
            manual_routing = true
          }
        }
      }
    ]
    vnet = {
      vnet_name   = "services-vnet-a"
      resource_id = "/subscriptions/11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555/resourceGroups/rg-a/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/services-vnet-a"
    }
  }
}
```

### Required

- `name` (String) name This is the name of configuration object. It has to be unique within the namespace. It can only be specified during create API and cannot be changed during replace API. The value of name has to follow DNS-1035 format.
- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''
